sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Let me check the current state and try to understand the controls better
seg = current_frame.segmentation
player = None
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'O':
        player = n
        break

if player:
    b = player['boundary']
    rows = [p[0] for p in b]
    cols = [p[1] for p in b]
    pr = (min(rows)+max(rows))/2
    pc = (min(cols)+max(cols))/2
    print(f"Player: row={pr}, col={pc}")

# Let me try pressing RIGHT to see if it moves the player right
print("\nPressing RIGHT 5 times:")
for i in range(5):
    action(['RIGHT'])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] == 'O':
            b = n['boundary']
            rows = [p[0] for p in b]
            cols = [p[1] for p in b]
            pr = (min(rows)+max(rows))/2
            pc = (min(cols)+max(cols))/2
            print(f"  After RIGHT {i+1}: row={pr}, col={pc}")
            break

# Check bird count
yellow_birds = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'Y' and n['pixels'] == 3]
print(f"\nYellow birds: {len(yellow_birds)}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
